summary: Set up Jira project, Confluence space, and Slack workflows for DataOps onboarding
description:
Issue summary: Data Platform needs a standardized onboarding workspace for new DataOps teams that includes a Jira project, Confluence space with templates, and Slack workflows to automate invites and checklist creation.
Impact: New teams onboarding are currently using ad-hoc spaces which causes duplicated effort, missing security controls, and inconsistent runbooks. This slows onboarding and increases risk for sensitive dataset access.
Request details:
- Create Jira project key DATOPS-ONB (company naming guidelines) with permission scheme scoped to Data Platform, Security, and Team leads. Roles: Admin, Developer, Viewer. Constrain Create/Transition of 'Access' issues to Admins only.
- Provision SSO group mappings in Jira: okta:group_dataops_engineers -> Developer, okta:group_dataops_leads -> Admin, okta:group_dataops_view -> Viewer.
- Create Confluence space 'DataOps Onboarding' with the attached skeleton pages: Welcome, Access Checklist, Runbooks, Compliance Evidence. Apply space permissions mirrored to Jira roles.
- Slack: create two channels #dataops-onboarding (private) and #dataops-guides (public read-only). Add a Slack Workflow (via Workflow Builder) that: 1) triggers on ticket creation in the Jira DATOPS-ONB project, 2) creates a private channel for the new team, 3) posts an onboarding checklist linking to Confluence pages, and 4) invites the SSO group okta:group_dataops_engineers.
- Jira automation rules: on issue created (template type = 'onboarding'): create sub-tasks from checklist template, add watchers: data-platform-oncall, assign to DataOps pod lead, and post a message to #dataops-onboarding with issue link.
- Webhooks: add a read-only webhook to GitHub org repo 'infrastructure/onboarding' for status updates.
Deadline: requested by 2026-03-20 to align with the next cohort.
Business justification: reduces time-to-first-delivery for teams by ~40%, enforces least-privilege, and centralizes audit trails.
Attachments: reference Confluence template draft (see related_confluence_pages).
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - configuration request rather than a bug. Provided runbook draft attached in Confluence.
